movie.overview: Years have passed since his last adventure, but José Luis Torrente, the most politically incorrect former cop in Spain, still sees himself as a national hero.
movie.title: Torrente for President

recommendations.title: Russell Howard: Recalibrate
recommendations.overview: Self-deprecating comic Russell Howard plows ahead through politics, porn, social media and his own shortcomings. Yet he somehow keeps it positive.

recommendations.title: In the Loop
recommendations.overview: The US President and the UK Prime Minister are planning on launching a war in the Middle East, but—behind the scenes—government officials and advisers are either promoting the war or are trying to prevent it.

recommendations.title: The Onion Movie
recommendations.overview: Venerable newscaster Norm Archer reports the latest news in politics, health, culture and entertainment - such as an automotive recall of decapitation-inducing "Neckbelts" and a study finding that "depression hits losers hardest". This compilation of bogus news stories, celebrity profiles, movie trailers and skits come courtesy of the ace satirists at The Onion.

recommendations.title: Ricky Gervais: Mortality
recommendations.overview: Ricky Gervais tackles life, death and the state of the world in a brutally honest special that spares no topic, even his own mortality.

recommendations.title: Bill Burr: Drop Dead Years
recommendations.overview: In what might be his most personal and introspective hour yet, Bill offers hilarious takes on everything from male sadness to dating advice.

recommendations.title: Dave Chappelle: Sticks & Stones
recommendations.overview: Dave Chappelle takes on gun culture, the opioid crisis and the tidal wave of celebrity scandals in this defiant stand-up special.

recommendations.title: Pretty Persuasion
recommendations.overview: A 15-year-old girl incites chaos among her friends and a media frenzy when she accuses her drama teacher of sexual harassment.

recommendations.title: Chris Rock: Bigger & Blacker
recommendations.overview: Chris Rock brings his critically acclaimed brand of social commentary-themed humour to this HBO Special, extolling his razor-sharp wit and wisdom on such topics as gun control, President Clinton, homophobia, racism, black leaders and relationships.

recommendations.title: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable...
recommendations.overview: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.

recommendations.title: Big Stan
recommendations.overview: A weak con man panics when he learns he's going to prison for fraud. He hires a mysterious martial arts guru who helps transform him into a martial arts expert who can fight off inmates who want to hurt or love him.

recommendations.title: Dave Chappelle: The Dreamer
recommendations.overview: From his onstage tackle to the slap heard round the world, Dave Chappelle lets loose in this freewheeling and unfiltered stand-up comedy special.

recommendations.title: Me Time
recommendations.overview: With his family away, a devoted stay-at-home dad enjoys his first me time in years by joining his hard-partying old friend on a wild birthday adventure.

recommendations.title: The Dictator
recommendations.overview: The heroic story of a dictator who risks his life to ensure that democracy would never come to the country he so lovingly oppressed.

recommendations.title: The Super
recommendations.overview: Louie Kritski is a heartless landlord who has been so negligent in keeping up his ghetto apartment that he is threatened with jail time. The judge gives him another option -- he must live in his rat-infested hell hole until he brings it up to liveable standards.

recommendations.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
recommendations.overview: Jack Spade returns from the army in his old ghetto neighbourhood when his brother, June Bug, dies. Jack declares war on Mr. Big, powerful local crimelord. His army is led by John Slade, his childhood idol who used to fight bad guys in the 70s.

recommendations.title: Desperate Living
recommendations.overview: After killing her husband, Peggy Gravel and her murderous maid Grizelda wind up in the crazy town of Mortville, where Queen Carlotta presides over a sleazy collection of misfits.

recommendations.title: Homo Argentum
recommendations.overview: The film consists of 16 shorts that explore, with humor and social criticism, the characteristics of the Argentine identity.

recommendations.title: No manches, Frida
recommendations.overview: After being released from prison, Zequi, a bank robber, sets out to recover money buried by his accomplice; but is horrified to learn that a high school gymnasium is now over the site where the loot is hidden.

recommendations.title: Jimmy Carr: Natural Born Killer
recommendations.overview: Jimmy Carr refutes the idea that you can't joke about anything these days with his edgy takes on gun control, religion, cancel culture and consent.

recommendations.title: One of Them Days
recommendations.overview: Best friends and roommates Dreux and Alyssa are about to have One of Them Days. When they discover Alyssa’s boyfriend has blown their rent money, the duo finds themselves going to extremes in a comical race against the clock to avoid eviction and keep their friendship intact.
